nodePort.description: Define the node port that will be exposed on the node

port.description: Define the port that will be exposed by the service

targetPort.description: Define the target port (No named ports)

protocol.description: Define the port protocol Used by the container ports and probes, http and https are converted to tcp where needed

appProtocol.description: Define the appProtocol of the port, used by the `Endpoint` and `EndpointSlice` objects (External IP)

hostPort.description: Define the hostPort, should be **avoided**, unless **ABSOLUTELY** necessary

protcol.description: Legacy misspelling of `protocol` in the protonmail-bridge chart values. The templates ignore this key, use `protocol` instead.
